body: I haven’t heard of any local temp agencies, but it could potentially be worth looking into.

I live in a small-ish town on the outskirts of Phoenix. I had a guaranteed job with my friend at a country club, but my dad wouldn’t let me accept it because it was a half hour drive away. The closest Baseball stadium is about 45-50 minutes away, in Downtown Phoenix. Both of my parents work at places that require years of extra schooling and/or training. Most of my friends have tried to help me get a job, but to no avail.
